verdict.rationale: Mintlify's own docs describe a built-in editor agent that edits pages, reorganizes navigation, updates docs.json, and manages dashboard settings. A Slack agent can be mentioned in a thread to open pull requests, and an admin MCP server lets AI tools edit content and settings. Together these let a user run core product operations through natural-language instructions. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent reliably carries out commands, and documentation of which operations (e.g., deployments, rollbacks) are or are not reachable through natural language.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The editor includes a built-in agent that can edit pages, reorganize navigation, update `docs.json`, search across your entire repository, and manage dashboard settings.
Use the editor's built-in AI agent to write content, edit pages, leave comments and suggestions, search your site, upload files, and configure settings.

Reads the full thread for context
- Opens a pull request in your docs repo
Give AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor write access to your Mintlify content and dashboard so they can edit pages, update settings, and open PRs.
